Maya: Quick sync — taking the 11:30 release window. We have model-routing (PR #412) + kv-cache patch (PR #416). Who owns which and who runs smoke? Need rollback readiness and a short preflight at 11:20.

Jon: I can own model-routing. I'll be on-call and run the canary at 5% -> 50% -> 100. Need someone to watch infra metrics (p95, errors).

Ash: I'll run smoke verification and post results. Smoke command I use: ```./scripts/smoke.sh --route model-routing --rps 20 --duration 90``` I'll push logs to #eng-sre.

Sarah: I can take the kv-cache patch. I want a quick perf baseline from staging before my canary — can someone run a couple of benchmark queries? @Stefan?

Stefan: Yep I can run perf baselines. No DB migrations in these PRs as far as I can see. I'll act as rollback backup if needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy reservation created for ticket INF-1234; window reserved 11:30-11:45 UTC; canary plan: 5%, 50%, 100; rollback-marker set.

Maya: Plan summary: 11:20 preflight (staging smoke + perf check), 11:25 lock traffic and tag owners, 11:30 deploy model-routing canary, 11:35 if green deploy kv-cache canary. Abort/rollback if p95 > baseline + 30% or error rate > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes. Notify product and @oncall. Please confirm. :thumbsup:

Jon: Confirmed — I'll post a short checklist when I start deploy.

Ash: Confirmed — will run smoke and paste short output here.

Sarah: Confirmed — will tag when perf baseline is done.

Stefan: Standing by.

Ash: smoke result (staging): OK — p95 68ms, errors 0%, throughput stable. Posting logs to #eng-sre and attaching link.

Maya: Great, thanks. We'll proceed as planned. If anything blocks, call it out in this thread and escalate to the oncall.
